mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the consumer price index above 3% y/y signals rising inflation expectations that erode real equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following CPI > 3% y/y, or the CPI spike explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that boosts wage pressures and inflation risks, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following UNRATE < 4%, or the UNRATE drop explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in industrial production growth below -2% y/y signals a supply shock that negatively impacts corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 70% of months following INDPRO < -2% y/y, or the INDPRO collapse explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales below -5% y/y signals a collapse in consumer demand that negatively impacts corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 70% of months following RSAFS < -5% y/y, or the RSAFS drop explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in nonfarm payrolls above 300k signals a surge in labor demand that boosts economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following PAYEMS > 300k, or the PAYEMS surge explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts above 1.5 million units signals a strong housing market that boosts economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following HOUST > 1.5m, or the HOUST rise explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that slows economic growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following the joint trigger condition, or the joint trigger explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.
